main_text.p: tenui contentam attenuat, ne videlicet illius infarctu fieret obstructio aliay occlusio meatuum illorum, per quos humores in Intestina ex ductu bilari, Intestinali, Pancreate, Stomacho aliisque meatibus profluant; vel etiam per quos Spiritus eo confluant; vel isto rum quoque per quos Chylus in reliquum corpus derivetur: vel etiam ne pituita illius abundantiâ Sensus aut motus Intestinorum amittatur, aut obtundatur, quò ad sequestrationem Chyli atque onerum Ventris excretionem segniores evadant, iisque impleantur & graveнтur, eorumque noxiis halitibus & vaporibus totum corpus inficiatur. quam pituitæ attenuationem Galenum necesse fcium humoris Pancreatici, soli bili adscripsisse, suprà probavimus. Deinde ut attenuata illa Pituita bilis fluorem & acredinem temperet. Huic luci tenebras objiciens p.25,26,27. Primùm inquit, frigore nequaquam denfari ho phlegma, quod tamen necesse est, si effer vescentiâ liquetur & contabescat. Cu

page.notes: The right edge of the scan cuts off the end of most lines, so the line endings are incomplete; visible letters are copied only. Some words at the cut are not legible and are left as printed in part. "graveнтur" is a misreading on my part and should be checked against the scan: the visible word is "gravantur". Text is in roman with italic passages; the italic is shown only where the scan shows it.
